findings.description: A PEM-encoded private key is committed to the repository.
findings.remediation: Remove the key from history (git filter-repo), rotate it, and store keys outside the repo.

findings.description: A GitHub personal access token is hardcoded.
findings.remediation: Revoke the token in GitHub settings and use repository or environment secrets instead.

findings.description: A SQL statement is built with template literal interpolation, allowing injection.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements instead of string interpolation.

findings.description: An API key appears to be hardcoded as a string literal.
findings.remediation: Load the API key from configuration/environment at runtime instead of committing it.
